slides.title: Moyale tensions spill into Kenya's border town
slides.body: Kenyan media report stray fire landing on the Kenyan side.

slides.title: Kenyan side affected
slides.body: Residents reported gunfire. Civilians were reported harmed, per Kenyan media. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Schools disrupted
slides.body: Exam candidates were moved from schools near the border. Unexploded ordnance was safely detonated.

slides.title: Displacement continues
slides.body: The UN estimates over 50,000 Ethiopians have crossed into Kenya, mainly Marsabit County.

slides.title: Protect civilians and keep aid and dialogue open.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica · Nov 4, 2026
